Any outpatient specialty that works from a consultation and examination room. We will settle the mix as planning goes on, so tell us yours when you register.

physicians.q: What will it cost, and how will booking work?
physicians.a: We plan to let you book rooms by the hour, the day or the month. Rates and terms are not published yet. Registered physicians will hear them from us first.

physicians.q: What do I get besides the room?
physicians.a: Reception, scheduling, administrative help and shared standards for the building. A laboratory is planned for a later phase, subject to approvals.
WAHP will meet Ghana's healthcare and facility regulations in full. We are working through the licensing and regulatory processes that national standards require.
Someone on our team reads your details and emails you to learn about your practice. We then keep you updated as the Accra hub takes shape.

patients.a: Not yet. WAHP is not open and is not seeing patients. We will say so clearly on this site when appointments start.
Our first hub will be in Accra. We will publish the address once it is confirmed.
No. WAHP runs the building and the support. The doctors you see there will be independent physicians running their own practices.
Send us a general enquiry from the contact page. Please do not include any health information.

diaspora.q: Do I need to move back to Ghana?
diaspora.a: No. You can start with clinics during the weeks you are already home and build from there. Nothing here asks you to give up your work abroad.

diaspora.q: Can I practise in Ghana with a licence from abroad?
diaspora.a: You are responsible for meeting Ghana's requirements to practise, including registration with the Medical and Dental Council. WAHP does not register doctors on their behalf.

diaspora.q: What does the partner path involve?
diaspora.a: Helping through your networks, your advice or your experience building institutions. Any formal role is agreed privately, one person at a time. Investment questions go through the investor page, and nothing on this site is an offer of securities.
